equipment.name: Hempen rope
equipment.description: A coil of rough rope stained by weather and old use.

equipment.name: Writ of attainder
equipment.description: A folded legal decree declaring Vharun Krell stripped of title and protection.

adventurers.name: Marrow
adventurers.journal: The player remained silent in the dark chamber, deferring character creation to the storyteller and waiting for the tale to unfold. — Day 1

equipment.name: Leather armor
equipment.description: Worn leather armor, flexible and silent.

equipment.name: Shortsword
equipment.description: A short blade, nicked and well-used.

equipment.name: Dagger
equipment.description: A small, wickedly sharp dagger.

equipment.name: Healing potion
equipment.description: A glass vial of ruby liquid that glows faintly.

equipment.name: Hooded lantern
equipment.description: A lantern with a hood to conceal its light.

equipment.name: Tinderbox
equipment.description: A small box with flint and steel.

equipment.name: Field rations
equipment.description: Two days' worth of dry, salty provisions.

equipment.name: Whisper talisman
equipment.description: A small oval of polished bone that hums faintly when near the dead.

adventurers.name: LÖLBERT
adventurers.time: Morning, Day 1 — bright sun, festival bells, and the smell of honey cakes
adventurers.journal: Lölbert approached the Silver Magistrates in the Sunwheel Plaza, where Caelith Vorn presented a black-waxed scroll sealed with a fire-wheel. The monument whispered their name and the Oath-Stone Amulet began to smoke as the magistrates demanded three answers before noon. — Day 1
adventurers.lore: The Oath-Stone Amulet began smoking in the plaza when the fire-wheel seal was revealed.

equipment.name: Rune-Scarred Greatsword
equipment.description: A prophecy-marked greatsword, its blade etched with old tribal runes and darkened by funeral smoke.

equipment.name: Ash-Walker Chain Mail
equipment.description: A heavy suit of blackened chain mail, still bearing the dents of your tribe's last stand.

equipment.name: Healing Draught
equipment.description: A pale green healing potion sealed with wax and a strand of elven hair.

equipment.name: Dried Boar Strips
equipment.description: Tough strips of preserved boar meat wrapped in bark.

equipment.name: Oath-Stone Amulet
equipment.description: A smooth gray amulet etched with wings, runes, and a rising sun.

equipment.name: Grave-Ash Bedroll
equipment.description: A dark traveling bedroll that smells of smoke, pine, and old rain.

equipment.name: Flint and Tinderbox
equipment.description: A small iron striker, flint, and dry tinder kept in a charred wooden box.

equipment.name: Whetstone of the First Camp
equipment.description: A coarse gray whetstone worn smooth by generations of warriors.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: You whisper a venomous insult, dealing psychic damage and imposing disadvantage on the target's next attack roll.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range, allowing you to distract, mislead, or conceal.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: A maddening tune audible only to the target deals psychic damage and forces it to flee if it fails its saving throw.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modi

equipment.name: Adderfang Rapier
equipment.description: A slender dueling blade with a dark green sheen and a hilt wrapped in shed serpent skin.

equipment.name: Silver-Fretted Lute
equipment.description: A dark-wood lute with silver frets, used for performance, seduction, and hidden signals.

equipment.name: Leather Armor
equipment.description: Supple dark leather armor, light enough for travel and quiet enough for whispered intrigue.

equipment.name: Healing Potion
equipment.description: A crimson liquid sealed in black wax, warm to the touch when danger is near.

equipment.name: Dried Nightberries
equipment.description: A small pouch of shriveled purple berries that taste of smoke and old rain.

equipment.name: Hemlock Vial
equipment.description: A tiny glass vial containing a thick green-black toxin.

equipment.name: Hempen Rope
equipment.description: Fifty feet of rough hemp rope, stained at one end with old blood.

equipment.name: Writ of Exile
equipment.description: A folded court decree bearing a broken noble seal and your outlawed name.

npcs.name: Sableine Fenn
npcs.note: Sableine warns that the presence below knows both the ring and the Rapier of the Pale Gallery.
npcs.desc: Sableine warns against listening at the trapdoor and advises using light or leaving it blind.

npcs.name: Mabel Puddlefoot
npcs.role: Cheerful chaotic shopkeeper of magical mishaps
npcs.note: Experimental potion maker who created fizzy root beer and enchanted linen underwear for the player.
npcs.desc: Runs a potion shop with bubbling cauldrons. Has purple hair held back with a dented ladle, goggles pushed up into her frizz, and an apron covered in potion stains and sparkles. Owes the player 50gp for a disappearing ink job but settled the debt with enchanted underwear worth 10gp instead. Cheerful…

npcs.name: Gristle
npcs.note: Blinded and coughing from smoke bomb, stumbling half-senseless into cabbage pile.
npcs.desc: Dwarf Guild enforcer with an itch in his lower back, prone to bathroom humor about prunes. Less sharp than his partner.
npcs.met_at: The character used a smoke bomb to escape from Gristle and Thistle, slipping into the marshlands toward the Sunken Vault of Giggling Gulp. — Day 1

npcs.name: Thistle Fardew
npcs.note: Blinded by smoke, waving arms blindly, dropped bounty notice in mud.
npcs.desc: Guild enforcer, focused on the bounty notice, squinting at the unflattering drawing of the player. Carries a quill.

npcs.name: Marsh sprite
npcs.note: Knows the answers to the vault's riddles. Warns about a hallway that causes uncontrollable laughter, sentient tea cakes that throw crumbs, and a gelatinous cube made of root beer. Mentions six other keys, one stuck in a frog's butt three days west.
npcs.desc: Tiny, warty marsh sprite, thumb-sized, holding a tiny wooden spoon and grinning widely with puffed cheeks. Waves the spoon and points at a half-buried rusted iron key.
npcs.met_at: Retrieved a warning vellum from the muck and arrived at the entrance of the Sunken Vault of Giggling Gulp with the marsh sprite. — Day 1

npcs.name: Gulper
npcs.note: Defeated and tangled in water lily stems, faceplanted in the marsh. Sputtering and too busy untangling itself to pose a threat.
npcs.desc: Beer-keg-sized slimy beast, fixated on the marsh sprite, snapping its blunt teeth. Currently distracted from the player.
npcs.met_at: Retrieved Vault Key #7 from the marsh muck while the marsh sprite distracted and defeated the gulper. — Day 1

npcs.name: Maren Voss
npcs.note: Bramble's End reeve and local Gray Veil chapter contact. Currently tight with fear over the undead situation; urgent and direct.
npcs.desc: Bramble's End reeve and local Gray Veil chapter contact. Currently tight with fear over the undead situation; urgent and direct.
npcs.met_at: Zoryn wakes in the Lower Sanctum and meets with Maren Voss, who reports three graves robbed and bodies missing. She gives Zoryn a key to the churchyard and urges tracking the undead before moonrise. — Day 1

npcs.name: Quenby Dustwhistle
npcs.note: Enthusiastic scavenger and tinker with knowledge of desert lore and ancient caravan routes. Spent three days prying memory shards from the temple forges. Carries a reinforced leather pack and alloy pry bar.
npcs.desc: Quenby is a glass harvester with a skiff, tools, water, and knowledge of which sand patches are deadly. She is skeptical of the player's request for a 50/50 split, recognizes the value of pre-Sundering alloy and the cracked memory core, and demands a good reason to trust the player.
npcs.met_at: Quenby Dustwhistle uses the Clean Blue Pane to reveal a hidden crack between broken obelisks, and the player's Memory Archive stirs with a fragment about an acolyte's pass. — Day 1

npcs.name: Veyra
npcs.role: Unknown entity seen within the Buried Temple
npcs.note: Spirit guide bound to the Ankhara Archive; dissolved into mist after the archive's liberation, her purpose fulfilled.
npcs.desc: Seen through the exposed corner of the Clean Blue Pane, standing just inside the wider temple door and facing the party.
npcs.met_at: The party's prayer summons rain to the desert for the first time in three millennia. Veyra dissolves into mist as the Archive's liberation completes, while Quenby celebrates the awakening seeds. — Day 5

npcs.name: Temple Glazier's Sentinel
npcs.note: A hunched humanoid construct of rough Ankhara basalt, just shy of human height. It carries a stone chisel and has a temple glazier's mark carved on its chest. It never stops working and guards temple passages. It can awaken the temple's old magic.
npcs.desc: A hunched humanoid construct of rough Ankhara basalt, just shy of human height. It carries a stone chisel and has a temple glazier's mark carved on its chest. It never stops working and guards temple passages. It can awaken the temple's old magic.
npcs.met_at: The party walked slowly past the Temple Glazier's Sentinel without touching the glass, then approached the bronze doors at the end of the corridor. — Day 1

npcs.name: Keeper of Paths
npcs.role: Ancient storyteller in the void — guides the adventurer's journey
npcs.note: A keeper of lost and forgotten things. Offered to seal the talisman in a blood-keyed iron lockbox — only the player's hand can open it — but warned the Hollow Forge reads relics to learn their truth, and without it the forge would have to read the player instead, a far more…
npcs.desc: A flicker of amber light where eyes might be; voice like stone grinding over stone. Self-described weaver of fates who asks the adventurer four questions about mood, goals, pact, and past before beginning.
npcs.met_at: The player declined to leave the obsidian talisman with the Keeper of Paths, choosing to keep it and travel up to the Upper Rings toward the Hollow Forge via the iron lung, while the messenger drone urges them to hurry to the lift. — Day 1

npcs.name: Kip
npcs.note: Swore a courier pact at Hollow Forge to carry messages and watch the player's back. Running passive scans, no Solke trackers found.
npcs.desc: Warns the player that the door seems to react to them; appears cautious but curious.
npcs.met_at: Kip scouted both routes and confirmed no Solke trackers. Party took a short rest. — Day 6

npcs.name: Messenger Drone
npcs.note: Cuffed and captured at the player's feet. Emitted a weak, garbled transmission about Merith's lost signal before falling to static. Now serves as a potential informant.
npcs.desc: Nervous, youthful voice; warns of danger; invites to the Lower Rings.
npcs.met_at: The player successfully persuades the Messenger Drone to reveal that four heavily armored enforcers are descending toward their position. Kaelen and Kip prepare a makeshift trap at the junction while the player weighs whether to descend into the amber-lit shaft or hold position. — Day 4

npcs.name: Ash Walker
npcs.note: Tog 4 skada (piercing)
npcs.desc: Calls you 'The Obsidian Ember' and claims to know the talisman's true nature. Says they mean no harm.
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Kaelen Voss
npcs.role: Relic hunter from the outer rings
npcs.note: Tog 4 skada (slashing)
npcs.desc: Relic hunter who has been chasing whispers of the Ash Witches for years. Claims to know the Upper Rings: the lifts, tolls, and foremen who don't ask questions. Travel-worn, armed with a blade, has dried blood on his cloak. Extends a hand in friendship but awaits the player's acceptance.
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Grist
npcs.role: Cargo lift operator at Mid-Ring docks
npcs.met_at: The party continued toward the Hollow Forge, passing through the Lower Rings and reaching the Mid-Ring docks, where they encountered the lift operator Grist. — Day 3

npcs.name: Vespera
npcs.note: Mirror-Vespera is a construct or projection, not the real Vespera. She is bound to the Mirror Chamber and serves as a guide/keeper of knowledge about the Cradle. She knows the history of all previous Vessels who attempted the Cradle's trial. Her scarred hand and hollow eyes…
npcs.desc: Identitet avslöjad: Kaelen cried out 'Vespera—' as the ash-robed woman stepped through the crucible fire and appeared physically before the player.
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Merith Solke
npcs.note: Controls the access shaft above the Cradle. Has 4 surveillance units and 2 shock troopers on rotating shifts. One drone disabled by the party — 3 remain. Likely stationed in her office in the Upper Rings behind glass walls. Holds the western sigil fragment needed to activate the…
npcs.desc: Tall, lean, dark leather coat with brass buttons shaped like closed eyes. Shaved head on one side, black hair falling past jaw on the other. Thin scar from temple to corner of mouth creating a permanent half-smirk. Speaks with a smoky, gravelly voice. Self-described trader in 'questions and…
npcs.met_at: Kip briefed the party on Merith Solke's forces: she holds the western sigil fragment in her Upper Rings office, guarded by three remaining drones and two shock troopers, and will likely move the fragment if she learns they are heading for the Cradle. — Day 6

npcs.name: Clerk
npcs.met_at: The player slipped on the ash-slick obsidian ledge, falling 15 feet onto Veyl's Lantern Court's lowest tier and taking 3 bludgeoning damage. The impact caused the obsidian talisman to pulse brightly, alerting two court clerks below. — Day 4

npcs.name: Surveillance Drone
npcs.note: Subdued and captured with manacles; ready for interrogation. No longer hostile.
npcs.desc: Subdued and captured with manacles; ready for interrogation. No longer hostile.
npcs.met_at: Kip accessed the captured surveillance drone's memory core, retrieving critical intel on Merith's forces, an unguarded maintenance tunnel to the Hollow Forge, and a bounty placed on Vespera. — Day 4

npcs.name: Ashen Ledger Scribe
npcs.role: Record keeper of the Ashen Ledger
npcs.note: Keeper of the Ashen Ledger's ancient records, knowledgeable about the Unbound Flame, the bloodline seal, and the Solke betrayal.
npcs.desc: Face obscured by an ash veil, speaks with a voice like turning parchment. Manages the Ashen Ledger's records, expects the party, and refuses to deal in tricks or half-truths. Addresses Vespera as the Vessel of the Unbound Flame.
npcs.met_at: The Ashen Ledger scribe revealed the player's bloodline oath to contain the Unbound Flame, the stolen sigil fragment in Merith Solke's office, and the full moon deadline for seal renewal. The player requested access to Vessel Cradle records to find a way to renew the sigil without sacrificing their… — Day 4

npcs.name: Scribe
npcs.role: Keeper of records in the Ashen Ledger
npcs.note: Ancient record-keeper with ash veil, voice like turning parchment. Knows the player's true name and refers to the obsidian talisman as the Unbound Flame.
npcs.desc: Ancient record-keeper with ash veil, voice like turning parchment. Knows the player's true name and refers to the obsidian talisman as the Unbound Flame.
npcs.met_at: The party stands in the Mirror Chamber, facing the sealed mirror inscribed with the ash-grey words. Kip examines the inscription while the brass keycard and obsidian talisman react to proximity. Kaelen was blocked by a stone flare from following through. — Day 6

npcs.name: Ashen Scribe
npcs.note: According to Kip, the Ashen Scribe claimed that every fire signs a debt, and that the Unbound Flame burns because it was promised fuel and never received it.
npcs.desc: Holds ancient knowledge of the Vessel Cradle, the location of the western sigil fragment in Merith Solke's office, and the impending seal collapse in three days.

npcs.name: Mirror-Vespera
npcs.role: Mirror reflection of Vespera within the Mirror Chamber
npcs.note: Revealed her true nature: she is not the player's soul split in half, but 'a copy of a memory that never happened.' Created by the Ash Witches during the first contract — they reached forward through the Cradle and took a memory from a Vessel who did not yet exist (the player)…
npcs.desc: This reflection or echo watches the blood offering and appears connected to the obsidian basin's contract magic.
npcs.met_at: The player left Mirror-Vespera and wiped pact-fire residue from the obsidian walls to conceal their presence from approaching drones. — Day 6

npcs.name: Guard
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Kaelithra the Unbroken
npcs.note: Dressed in skimpy leather, tight rope shibari corset, steel collar etched with the player's patron sigil, and leather muzzle; fully submissive, her violet sigil flares in sync with the player's.
npcs.desc: Half clockwork (brass/iron mechanical left half with steam-emitting joints) and half scarred human, wields a serrated steam-powered glaive. Sold Xylith to the Thirsting Coin for three border villages, intends to break Xylith before sacrificing their soul to the god that banished them.
npcs.met_at: The player meets Elowen the Unblemished at the agreed meeting point, attempting to gain her trust while Kaelithra the Unbroken lurks unseen nearby, ready to ambush on signal. — Day 1

npcs.name: Nyxara
npcs.note: Identified the Heart-Cog, warned that it requires Warden clearance to possess legally, and suggested a discreet buyer in Vell-Kora named Kaelen Moss.
npcs.desc: Scholarly archivist with tarnished-silver eyes and a cracked leather ledger. Warns of the Iron Gate, missing volumes, and a loose floorboard. Smells of old paper and damp clay.
npcs.met_at: Qyrel finishes off the Rust-Husk and pockets its pulsing Heart-Cog. Nyxara identifies the artifact, warns of its dangerous nature, and points toward a discreet merchant in Vell-Kora. — Day 1
